stages.name: Adippadai
stages.subtitle: Tamil Basics
stages.blurb: What Tamil is, how its writing system is built, and your first sounds.

milestone.title: Thodakkam
milestone.desc: You understand how Tamil writing works.

blocks.h: One of the world's oldest living languages
blocks.p: Tamil (தமிழ்) has been spoken and written continuously for over 2,000 years. It is an official language in India, Sri Lanka and Singapore, with around 80 million speakers.

blocks.h: You already know the hardest part: showing up
blocks.p: Tamil script looks unfamiliar, but it is remarkably logical. Unlike English, Tamil is almost perfectly phonetic — once you know a letter, you always know its sound. No silent letters, no surprises.
Seven stages. Each stage has lessons, then a milestone quiz. Pass the quiz and the next stage unlocks. Kili will be with you the whole way.
12 vowels. They can stand alone and be pronounced on their own. Think of them as the soul of a syllable.
blocks.ta: அ ஆ இ ஈ உ ஊ எ ஏ ஐ ஒ ஓ ஔ

blocks.p: 18 consonants. A dot on top (called pulli · புள்ளி) means the consonant has no vowel attached. A body with no life cannot be spoken alone.
blocks.ta: க் ங் ச் ஞ் ட் ண் த் ந் ப் ம் ய் ர் ல் வ் ழ் ள் ற் ன்

blocks.p: Combine a body with a life and you get a speakable syllable. 18 consonants × 12 vowels = 216 combinations. You will never memorise 216 things — you learn 30 pieces and combine them.
blocks.ta: க் + அ = க      க் + ஆ = கா      க் + இ = கி

blocks.p: A single extra letter, ஃ, written as three dots. Rare, but it completes the alphabet: 12 + 18 + 1 = 31 base letters.

content.note: Traditional Tamil numerals. Modern Tamil uses 1 2 3, but these appear in old texts, temple inscriptions and calendars.

questions.q: How many uyir (vowel) letters does Tamil have?
What is the dot placed above a consonant called?
How do you say 'Thank you' in Tamil?
Uyirmei letters are formed by combining...
How many uyirmei combinations exist in total?
The Tamil numeral ௫ represents which number?

stages.name: Ezhuthukkal
stages.subtitle: Tamil Letters
stages.blurb: All 12 vowels, 18 consonants, and the grid that combines them.

milestone.title: Ezhuthu Arivu
milestone.desc: You can recognise every Tamil letter.

content.note: Tap any letter to hear it. Short and long pairs sit next to each other: அ/ஆ, இ/ஈ, உ/ஊ.
Each carries a pulli (dot) on top, meaning 'no vowel attached'. Tamil has three l-sounds (ல ள ழ) and three n-sounds (ந ண ன) — these take practice.
18 rows × 12 columns = 216 living letters. Pick any cell to see how the body and the life join together.
These pairs trip up every beginner. Study the small differences carefully.

example.en: ங has a flat top bar; ஈ has a hook
ன is a simple loop; ண has an extra curl
ல opens upward, ன opens sideways
ச has a longer tail sweeping right
வ is closed at the bottom left
ழ has the signature inner curl — the sound Tamil is famous for

questions.q: The word தமிழ் ends with which letter?
Which of these is a mei (consonant) letter?
Which vowel is the long form of உ?
How many mei letters are there?
Which pair is most often confused by beginners?

stages.name: Ezhuthu Payirchi
stages.subtitle: Writing Practice
stages.blurb: Trace real Tamil letters with your finger. Kili scores every stroke.

milestone.title: Kai Ezhuthu
milestone.desc: You can write Tamil letters by hand.

content.note: Draw over the grey letter. Kili scores your coverage and your neatness.
Longer vowels have more curves. Slow down — accuracy beats speed.
Write the body first, then add the pulli dot on top.
The letters that define Tamil handwriting. ழ is the one to master.
Full words now. Take your time — this is the milestone challenge.

questions.q: When writing a mei letter, where does the pulli go?
Which vowel sign is added to க to make கா?
Which letter is generally considered the hardest to write?
Tamil is traditionally written in which direction?
What does removing the pulli from க் produce?
The word அம்மா contains how many mei-with-pulli letters?

stages.name: Sollkal
stages.subtitle: Words & Vocabulary
stages.blurb: Build a working vocabulary: family, food, colours, animals, verbs.

milestone.title: Sol Vangi
milestone.desc: You hold a starter vocabulary of everyday Tamil.

content.note: Tamil verbs are given here in the root form used for commands.

questions.q: Which of these is a food word?

stages.name: Vaakkiyangal
stages.subtitle: Sentences
stages.blurb: Put words in Tamil order and form real sentences.

milestone.title: Vaakkiya Amaippu
milestone.desc: You can build and read Tamil sentences.

blocks.p: English says 'I eat rice'. Tamil says 'I rice eat'. The verb almost always lands at the end of the sentence. Once this clicks, Tamil sentences stop looking scrambled.
blocks.ta:
நான் சாதம் சாப்பிடுகிறேன்.
naan saatham saappidugiREn.
(I) (rice) (eat) → I eat rice.

blocks.p: Tamil usually drops the verb 'to be' in simple statements. 'This is a book' is simply 'This book'.
blocks.ta:
இது புத்தகம்.
ithu puththagam.
This (is a) book.

blocks.p: Attach the suffix -ஆ to turn a statement into a yes/no question.
blocks.ta:
இது புத்தகமா?
ithu puththagamaa?
Is this a book?

content.note: Tap the words in the correct Tamil order.

questions.q: What is the standard Tamil word order?
Which suffix turns a statement into a yes/no question?
How do you ask 'What is your name?'
In 'நான் தமிழ் படிக்கிறேன்', which word is the verb?
Tamil simple statements usually omit which verb?

stages.name: Vasippu
stages.subtitle: Reading
stages.blurb: Read connected Tamil passages and answer comprehension questions.

milestone.title: Vasippu Thiran
milestone.desc: You can read and understand short Tamil passages.

lines.en: Kili is a green bird.
It woke up in the morning.
Kili ate a fruit.
Then it sat on the tree.
Kili sang a Tamil song.
Mother went to the shop.
She bought rice and fruit.
“How much is this?” she asked.
The shopkeeper said “fifty rupees”.
Mother paid and came home.

content.note: A classic folk tale, retold in simple Tamil.

lines.en: A crow was very thirsty.
It saw a pot.
There was a little water in the pot.
The crow dropped stones in.
The water rose up.
The crow drank the water. Cleverness is strength!

questions.q: What did the crow put in the pot?
In 'அம்மா கடைக்குப் போனார்', what does போனார் mean?
The suffix -உம் ... -உம் is used to mean...
Which sentence means 'It saw a pot'?

stages.name: Puthagangal
stages.subtitle: Reading Tamil Books
stages.blurb: Step into real Tamil literature — Thirukkural and Aathichoodi.

milestone.title: Ilakkiya Payanam
milestone.desc: You can read classical Tamil literature. The journey is complete.

blocks.p: The oldest body of Tamil poetry: Kurunthogai, Purananuru, Natrinai. Poems about love, war, land and longing, written two thousand years ago and still startlingly direct.
1,330 couplets by Thiruvalluvar on virtue, wealth and love. Each kural is just seven words. It is the most quoted Tamil text in the world and the perfect first book — short units, huge ideas.
Written by the poet Avvaiyar for children: one short moral line per letter of the alphabet. This is where most Tamil children begin reading.
Once you are comfortable with the classics, modern novels and short stories open up. But start where Tamil itself starts — with Avvaiyar.

content.note: By Avvaiyar. One line per letter, in alphabetical order. Written for beginners — exactly like you.

lines.en: Desire to do good deeds.
Anger is a thing to be cooled.
Do not hide what you are able to give.
Do not prevent charity.
Do not boast of what you own.

questions.q: Why is Aathichoodi arranged this way?

content.note: Chapter 40, Kalvi (Learning). By Thiruvalluvar, roughly 2,000 years old.

lines.ta:
கற்க கசடறக் கற்பவை கற்றபின்
நிற்க அதற்குத் தக.
lines.tr: kaRka kasadaRak kaRpavai kaRRapin / niRka atharkuth thaga.
lines.en: Learn thoroughly what is worth learning — then live by what you have learned.

lines.ta:
தொட்டனைத் தூறும் மணற்கேணி மாந்தர்க்குக்
கற்றனைத் தூறும் அறிவு.
lines.tr: thottanaith thuuRum maNaRkeeNi maantharkkuk / kaRRanaith thuuRum aRivu.
lines.en: As a sand-well yields water the deeper you dig, so knowledge flows the more one learns.

lines.ta:
கேடில் விழுச்செல்வம் கல்வி ஒருவற்கு
மாடல்ல மற்றை யவை.
lines.tr: keedil vizhuchchelvam kalvi oruvaRku / maadalla maRRai yavai.
lines.en: Learning is the imperishable wealth; all other riches are not true wealth.

questions.q: What image describes knowledge growing with study?
According to the third kural, what is the imperishable wealth?
How many lines does a kural have?

content.note: No transliteration crutch on the first read. Try it in Tamil alone, then check yourself.

lines.en: Tamil is an ancient language.
For two thousand years people have written in Tamil.
Sangam literature is the oldest body of books.
The Thirukkural spread throughout the world.
Now you too are reading Tamil.
This is only a beginning. Congratulations!

questions.q: What does the final line say?
How many kurals are there in total?
A kural consists of how many words?
